metadata.name: Riot Entry - Riftbound (Browser)
metadata.description: Signs eligible saved riotgames.com accounts into the Riftbound XSSO client and enters them in the Riftbound T1 Signature Edition product-registration drawing (campaign 31, item RB3864-00-00). The browser flow clears cookie prompts before sign-in, rotates immediately when Riot blocks a proxy, fails fast on an invalid CAPTCHA selection, handles email MFA, product + legal consent, and confirmation, then writes the shared entry marker to the account and Inventory. Only a newly submitted entry emits a success webhook, including the exact proxy used; already-entered accounts are recorded without a duplicate success notification.

inputs.label: Save folder (optional)
inputs.hint: Names this run's Inventory rows, the same as the native riot-entry tool's --event-name. Entered accounts keep whichever Database folder they are already in.

inputs.label: Re-check entered accounts
inputs.hint: Off: an account already marked as entered for this campaign is skipped without opening a browser - including entries made by the requests-based riot-entry tool, which writes the same marker. On: open the page and confirm with Riot instead.
